queries.query: Manfalut Egypt official cadastral map parcels land registry GIS Egyptian Survey Authority
queries.result: Found the first-party Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) national site and its map/service pages. ESA describes paper and digital maps, land-ownership/parcels and survey services, but no public Manfalut parcel viewer, API, schema, or anonymous parcel response was found. A Manfalut planning decision and general land-allocation references were found, but they are not a parcel service.

queries.query: منفلوط أسيوط خريطة مساحية قطع الأراضي الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة السجل العيني
queries.result: Found ESA Arabic institutional and service pages, an official/publication reference to the detailed planning decision for Manfalut, and an Egyptian Tax Authority office page identifying Manfalut coverage. No first-party public Manfalut cadastral map/API or anonymous parcel feature response was found.

localCustodian.name: Assiut Survey Directorate / Manfalut local registry (not independently evidenced as a public parcel service)
localCustodian.evidence: The searches identified Manfalut as covered by Assiut/Manfalut administrative and tax references, but did not establish a local registry endpoint, viewer, downloadable parcel layer, or public schema.

generalAgency.name: Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA)
generalAgency.scope: National/general survey, paper-map and digital-map services. ESA material says its products can depict private land ownership/parcels, but the inspected public pages provide no anonymous city-specific parcel query.

runtimeReadiness.reason: No independently qualified Manfalut adapter or citywide public parcel source was evidenced.
